name: ariadne-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is `ariadne`, a Python library for building schema-first GraphQL
servers on top of `graphql-core`: it binds Python resolvers and other bindables to schemas written
in SDL, executes GraphQL operations, and serves them over ASGI and WSGI, with extensions,
subscriptions and contrib packages. Starlette, python-multipart and httpx are installed in this
environment; there is no network access.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is Ariadne's own schema-first GraphQL layer: the ariadne package's top-level modules, its asgi (with asgi/handlers), explorer, validation and subscription_handlers packages, and the Python modules of its contrib federation package, its contrib relay package and contrib/sse module; together with the documentation pages under docs/01-Docs (every page except dataloaders), docs/03-Security (security overview, hiding field suggestions and disabling stack traces), docs/04-Servers (asgi and wsgi), docs/05-Integrations (starlette integration), docs/06-Extensions (extensions, middleware, query validators and query stack) and docs/07-Contrib (graphql relay), README.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of those modules, including their examples.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a d
